name: Roronoa Zoro
effect:
If there is a Character with a cost of 12 or more, this Character gains +3000 power.
If one of your Characters would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may place 3 cards from your trash at the bottom of your deck in any order instead.

official_faq.question: If this Character itself would leave the field due to an opponent's effect, can I instead place 3 cards from my trash at the bottom of my deck in any order?
If 2 of my Characters would leave the field at the same time due to an opponent's effect, do I have to place 6 cards from my trash at the bottom of my deck in any order?
official_faq.answer: In this case, you can place 3 cards from your trash at the bottom of your deck in any order, and if you do, neither Character leaves the field.
